channel.description: Art workshop guides, event write-ups, and craft tips from Kraftykinni — Delhi NCR.

item.title: A Block Printing Workshop in Delhi, for a Mother and Daughter Visiting from Israel
item.description: A mother and daughter travelling through India reached out to Kraftykinni for a private lesson in traditional block printing — set up right in their hotel room. Here is how the afternoon actually went, paint spill included.

item.title: World Environment Day 2026 — How Upcycled Bottle Art Makes Sustainability Hands-On
item.description: World Environment Day falls on 5 June every year — and this year, instead of a pledge or a social post, we want to show you what sustainability looks like when you put paint, clay, and a discarded bottle in front of a group of people.

item.title: Father's Day Gift Ideas 2026 — Handmade Art Workshops in Delhi NCR
item.description: A tie he won't wear. A mug with \"World's Best Dad\" he already has three of. This Father's Day, gift something handmade — a Fevicryl Mouldit Clay Fridge Magnet, Father's Day Special Bottle Art, Clay Bottle Art, or a handmade Clay Trinket created in a guided art workshop experience in Delhi NCR.

item.title: Summer Art Workshops for Schools in Delhi NCR — A Complete Planning Guide
item.description: Summer is the one window in the school calendar where there's room to try something outside the syllabus. No exam pressure, smaller groups, and students who actually want to be there — the conditions for a genuinely great workshop are perfect. Here's what schools in Delhi NCR are booking, what works by age group, and how to plan one well.

item.title: Mother's Day Art Workshop Gift Ideas in Delhi NCR — Make Something She'll Keep
item.description: Flowers wilt by Tuesday. A handmade Lippan Art plaque, a painted bottle lamp, or a clay keepsake — those stay on the shelf for years. This Mother's Day, give her an experience she makes with her own hands, and takes home as something real.

item.title: Bottle Lamp Art Workshop for Schools: How Jaypee Public School Noida Did It
item.description: 150+ students at Jaypee Public School Greater Noida turned empty glass bottles into handcrafted decorative lamps using Fevicryl Mouldit and Acrylic Colours — and every single one took their finished piece home on the day.

item.title: Lippan Art — A Complete Beginner's Guide to Kutch Mirror Work
item.description: Lippan Art is a 500-year-old craft from the Kutch region of Gujarat, and it produces some of the most striking wall pieces you'll see in Indian craft. Clay, mirrors, and geometric patterns — here's everything you need to know before your first session.

item.title: Clay Trinket Painting Workshop at Cars24 Gurgaon — 40 Participants, One Relaxing Afternoon
item.description: 40 Cars24 employees in Gurgaon sat down with clay, brushes, and Fevicryl colours on 29 April. Two hours later, every single one of them walked out holding something they had made themselves. This is how a Clay Trinket Painting session works when it actually works.

item.title: Art Workshop Ideas for Birthday Parties in Delhi NCR
item.description: The standard Delhi birthday party formula — venue, buffet, DJ, go home — produces a fine evening. But after running art sessions for birthday groups across South Delhi, Gurgaon, and Noida, we've noticed something: guests who make something together remember the evening very differently from guests who just attended it.

item.title: Annual Day Activity Ideas for Schools in Delhi NCR (Art-Based Edition)
item.description: Most schools start planning their annual day in April or May — when the academic calendar clears and the event committee starts arguing about what to do. If you're looking for activities that go beyond a generic craft stall and actually produce something students are proud of, this list is for you.

item.title: Best Corporate Team Building Activities in Gurgaon 2026
item.description: Gurgaon's corporate event scene is full of options — escape rooms, bowling, and go-karting have their place. But after running 50+ team workshops across Cyber City and Udyog Vihar, we've seen which activities actually produce conversation, connection, and something teams talk about months later.
